name: ClonalTree (B-DIVE)
summary: Reconstructs B-cell receptor lineage trees from clonally related sequences using a minimum-spanning-tree algorithm combined with genotype abundance information.
capabilities: Minimum-spanning-tree lineage reconstruction with abundance weighting
AIRR/IMGT formatting, clustering and refinement pipeline
Configurable distance methods (V, J, CDR3) and clonotype grouping (L1–L5)
